name: Usability heuristic reviewer
why: Checks a page or form against ten usability rules and ranks fixes by harm, the same method as the usability review skill.

name: Review a page's ease of use, then plan a test
why: Pairs a quick review with a one-morning test plan, matching the review-then-test order in this role.

name: Small usability test planner
why: Writes tasks, a read-aloud script and a fix list for a small test, like the usability test plan prompt.

name: Check a prototype before user testing
why: Finds gaps and dead ends in a prototype before sessions, so a test finds the deeper problems.

name: Error message rewriter
why: Rewrites error messages to say what went wrong and what to do next, the core of the microcopy skill.

name: Write helpful error and empty states
why: Covers the error and empty states the wireframe spec and microcopy skills insist on.

name: Make a long form easier to finish
why: Cuts and restructures long forms, useful for sign-up and checkout flows with too many fields.

name: Turn a design review into fixes
why: Turns review comments into numbered tasks with owners and done-when, the hand-over step after a review.

name: Give developers a complete component brief
why: Specifies components with states and words for a developer, alongside a text wireframe spec.

name: New screen design reviewer
why: Checks each new screen against your own design rules before it ships, a lighter repeatable review.

name: Quarterly accessibility keeper
why: Re-checks accessibility gaps each quarter and keeps statement notes current, after the quick check finds the first issues.

name: Find where new users leave and prove the fix works
why: Finds the biggest drop-off from your numbers and plans a test of the fix, a good input to a usability review.
